SPIRV-Cross sdk-1.3.239.0 (4212eef67ed0ca048cb726a6767185504e7695e5)
https://github.com/KhronosGroup/SPIRV-Cross
Only the files needed for the HLSL backend and the C API are included.
Patched for toolchains where uint32_t is unsigned long: two max() calls in
spirv_glsl.cpp and the Parser call in spirv_cross_c.cpp.
